::: {#def-dyad .theorem}
## Dyad

In a [bipartite](#def-bipartite-npsem-ge) [graph generator](#def-npsem-ge) $\boldsymbol\psi$ with persons $\mathcal P$ and places $\mathcal Q$, the **dyad** of a person $i \in \mathcal P$ and a place $j \in \mathcal Q$ is their relational variable, taken as a single variable:

$$
D_{ij} = \psi(i,j) = \psi(j,i), \qquad i \in \mathcal P,\ j \in \mathcal Q.
$$

A person's row $\boldsymbol\Psi_i$ is the collection of their dyads, $(D_{ij})_{j \in \mathcal Q}$.
:::
